rawText: J.M. Boillot — Bourgogne — Appellation Bourgogne Contrôlée — Mis en bouteille par Jean-Marc Boillot à Pommard, Côte-d'Or, France — Product of France - Contient des sulfites - Contains sulphites
description: Domaine Jean-Marc Boillot is based in Pommard, Côte-d'Or, and produces this regional Bourgogne AOC from Chardonnay grapes sourced from various parcels across the Côte de Beaune. The appellation permits yields up to 65 hl/ha and requires the wine to be made entirely from Chardonnay for white Bourgogne. Jean-Marc Boillot took over the family domaine in the late 1980s, having previously worked at Olivier Leflaive, and is known for precise, terroir-driven Burgundy whites.
